proposal.initialization: Repeat V13 seeded fresh initialization; human approved

objective.mechanism: one boundary-balanced adjacent-transition BCE term added to original V13 loss
objective.targets: binary indicators from adjacent actual teacher mode labels only
objective.reduction: per-type mean positive BCE and mean negative BCE averaged if both present; only present group otherwise; four-type mean; zero if no eligible pairs
objective.formula: original mean CE + Chase-only steering MSE + 0.1 * boundary_BCE
objective.eligibility: same match; both ball present; strictly increasing time; actual callback dt >0 and <=0.1 s
objective.chunk_boundary: detached cached preceding probabilities; labels/masks/time from actual preceding callback; no extra forward or reset

training.selection: minimum original unweighted validation loss; strict improvement; earliest tie
